title: Acecore Designs
description: Explore 13 Acecore Designs services for characters, illustration, 3D, stories, scripts and audio, with tax-inclusive starting prices.
heroTitle: Turn your ideas into creative work.
heroLead: Acecore Designs supports businesses, shops, schools, organizations and individuals with design, 3D, writing and audio production through one contact point.
conditionsBody: Prices include tax and cover the basic scope described. We confirm intended use, scope, revisions, schedule, file formats and usage terms before quoting. Materials and additional work are quoted before agreement.
flowBody: Acecore receives your inquiry and confirms feasibility. Production begins after agreement on the estimate and scope, followed by review, revisions and delivery.
creatorBody: Explore Hatt’s published character designs, 3D work and fiction. Acecore handles project inquiries and estimates.
schoolsTitle: Training and creative support at Acecore Schools
schoolsBody: We also offer introductory 3D training, individual technical support, illustration and writing reviews, and creative workshops.

services.title: Character design
services.description: Original characters tailored to businesses, shops, products, games and publicity.

services.title: Additional mascot and character illustrations
services.description: One new pose, expression or seasonal illustration of an existing character for social media, promotional materials or merchandise.

services.title: Character sheets and three-view drawings
services.description: Front, side and back views with colors for 3D production, animation and collaboration.

services.title: Book and booklet cover illustrations
services.description: Cover artwork for books, e-books, newsletters and teaching materials. Typography is quoted separately.

services.title: Editorial and explanatory illustrations
services.description: One small illustration to support an article, manual, teaching material or booklet.

services.title: Stickers and reaction images
services.description: A set of three character expressions or actions for communities, streaming, apps and campaigns.

services.title: Original 3D character production
services.description: 3D characters for video, games, exhibitions and virtual spaces. Motion, expressions and target environments are quoted individually.

services.title: 3D props and objects
services.description: One 3D prop, decorative object or exhibit for video, games, virtual exhibitions or product visualization.

services.title: Existing 3D model customization
services.description: Adjust colors, shapes, clothing or accessories for new uses of existing characters and events.

services.title: 3D effects and interactive features
services.description: One feature such as visibility switching, lighting or effects. Intended use and supported environments are confirmed in advance.

services.title: Original story writing
services.description: Approximately 4,000 Japanese characters based on your theme, characters and setting for web content, booklets or audio works.

services.title: Video and audio script writing
services.description: Approximately 2,000 Japanese characters of dialogue or narration for introductory videos, audio drama and other content.

services.title: Narration and reading recordings
services.description: Record up to 1,000 Japanese characters of supplied text and deliver audio for videos, teaching materials, guidance or readings.
